title: Mallard Sample Deletion
notes: Added permanent sample deletion from the sample detail screen.
Deletion requires a confirmation message that names the sample number and warns that the action cannot be undone.
Deleting a sample also removes its related lab test rows and history through database cascades without leaving orphaned records.
Deleted sample numbers are not returned to the numbering pool or reused.
Kept Archive as a separate non-destructive option for records that should only be hidden from the active list.
